## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

[PROMPT TYPE]
MiniMax H3 text-to-video. No reference images. Single continuous 4-second shot, cinematic live-action realism.

[CHARACTER]
白鹿: a serene student with silver-white short hair and heterochromia — one ice-blue eye, one pale-gold eye — wearing an ivory-white academy uniform, distinctly different from the dark navy and black uniforms worn by the other students in the hall. She stands completely motionless, calm, no smile, no gesture. Her face must be original and generic-realistic, not resembling any stylized or anime character.

[SCENE]
Interior of a grand gothic academy chapel, facing the large wooden entrance door at the rear of the nave. Long rows of wooden pews and a stone floor lead toward the door; high vaulted ceiling and tall red-and-blue stained-glass windows frame the space. The nave is dim and hushed; seated students in dark uniforms remain blurred and unfocused in the foreground pews.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–1.2 seconds — The great entrance door is pushed open from outside; bright white daylight floods in and forms a huge volumetric light column cutting through the dim nave. Faint dust motes drift in the beam.
1.2–4.0 seconds — 白鹿 stands alone at the center of the light column, full-body distance, viewed from inside the chapel against the light. Her silver-white short hair is rim-lit, her heterochromatic eyes faintly readable, her ivory-white uniform glowing as if wrapped in light. She does not walk, wave or turn. The hall falls into complete silence.

[CAMERA]
16:9 cinematic framing, wide full-body distance, interior angle facing the door. Completely fixed camera once the door opens — no push-in, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no handheld shake, no reframing.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
One dominant white volumetric light column from the open door backlights 白鹿 with a bright rim and halo; the rest of the nave stays in low-saturation cool shadow with soft red-blue tints from the stained glass. Clean transparent image, soft natural light, Arri Alexa-like color science, filmic highlight rolloff, fine subtle film grain, low-saturation cool grade. Live-action realistic youth campus drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
A single heavy wooden door-hinge creak as the door swings open, then near-total silence: pipe organ and crowd murmur stop completely, leaving only a thin ambient air tone inside the chapel. No music, no voices, no abrupt audio cutoff.

[NEGATIVES]
No walking, no waving, no smiling, no extra characters in focus, no identity resembling a pre-existing celebrity or stylized character, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no song, no anime / 3D / CG look, no camera movement, no lens flare abuse, no oversaturation, no warm golden grade, no flicker, no watermark, no logo, no distorted eyes, heterochromia mismatch, or deformed hands.

[PROMPT TYPE]
MiniMax H3 text-to-video. No reference images. Single continuous 5-second shot, cinematic wuxia live-action realism.

[CHARACTERS]
古装女子: late-20s Chinese woman in a flowing white hanfu robe with wide sleeves and an emerald silk sash, long black hair partly tied up with a silver hairpin, wielding a slender straight sword (jian). Her face is original and realistic, calm and focused.
古装男子: mid-30s Chinese man in a dark-grey warrior robe with leather shoulder guards, hair tied back with a dark headband, a short beard, wielding a single broadsword (dao). His face is original and realistic, fierce and controlled.
The two are clearly distinct people; neither resembles any celebrity or stylized character.

[SCENE]
A vast shan-shui landscape: towering misty karst peaks, a still green lake in the middle ground, and a shallow rocky shore in the foreground where the two fight. Thin morning mist drifts between the mountains; a few tall pines lean at the water edge; pale sky with soft early-morning light. No buildings, no other people.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–2.5 seconds — Wide framing by the water: the two clash mid-stride, sword and broadsword ringing together, sparks glinting; the woman spins low with her sash streaming, the man counters with a heavy sweeping block; water droplets kick up from the shallow shore.
2.5–5.0 seconds — The woman leaps off a wet rock and strikes downward from above; the man parries and pushes her back several paces across the stones; both settle into guarded stances facing each other, blades raised, mist drifting between them; hold the standoff.

[CAMERA]
16:9 cinematic framing. Wide distance keeping both fighters fully readable, one slow lateral tracking move during the clash; no whip pans, no cuts, no zoom pumping, no disorienting shake. Mountains and water stay visible in the background throughout.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Soft cool morning light with pale silver rim light on robes and hair; mist catches gentle god rays between peaks. Clean transparent image, filmic highlight rolloff, Arri Alexa-like color science, low-saturation cool grade, fine subtle film grain. Live-action realistic wuxia drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
Clear metallic sword-clash rings, whooshing fabric and blade cuts, quick footwork on wet stone, a soft splash as droplets scatter; thin wind through pines and distant water lapping as ambience. No music, no dialogue, no voice-over.

[CONTINUITY]
Both characters keep the same face, hairstyle, costume and weapon for the whole shot; the landscape, mist and light stay consistent; the woman's white robe and the man's grey robe never swap or change color.

[NEGATIVES]
No identity resembling any pre-existing celebrity or stylized character, no extra fighters, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no song, no anime / 3D / CG look, no teleporting or floaty weightless motion, no limbs passing through bodies, no duplicated swords, no deformed hands or faces, no flickering costumes, no oversaturation, no watermark, no logo, no gore.
